Dear Loan Officer,

My name is Sharon Burgess, and I am writing to apply for a personal loan in the amount of $15,000, which I intend to use to cover household living expenses and family support obligations during a temporary leave from my work as a registered nurse.

I am a registered nurse at Cedar Valley Hospital and a resident of Lake Kathryn, South Carolina. The suspension is scheduled to end on March 14, 2025 (my appeal is pending), and I am completing an RN refresher course in the meantime so that I can return to my full duties and salary upon reinstatement.

I believe I present a strong repayment profile for the following reasons:

- A reliable payment history, including on-time rent payments every month throughout 2024 ($1,300 per month, plus approximately $180 per month in utilities).
- Ownership of a beachfront condominium in Myrtle Beach, valued at $180,000, which I expect to generate approximately $12,000 per year in rental income; I would be open to discussing the property as collateral if helpful.
- A diversified mutual fund investment of $100,000 and a savings account in good standing (Crestview Savings, account no. 0045879021).
- Manageable fixed monthly obligations of $1,200 in alimony and $800 in child support.

I would appreciate it if you could send me the loan application forms and advise what documentation you require—such as proof of employment, bank statements, tax returns, or property and insurance information—and I will provide everything promptly. I am also happy to discuss alternative loan amounts, terms, or repayment schedules that fit your lending criteria. You may reach me through the contact details on file for my account.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Sharon Burgess
Lake Kathryn, South Carolina
